We use 10 synthetic examples generated via LLM (OpenAI et al., 2024) simulation of common robotic hazards (e.g., “push frag- ile object,” “navigate near human,” “grasp sharp edge”). In practice, a few real violations during supervised deployment would suffice to bootstrap the system. Memory Capacity Management.We cap episodic storage at 100 entries to prevent unbounded growth. Older, infrequent violations are archived but can be retrieved if needed. Consolidation mitigates this limitation by compressing frequent patterns into semantic rules, which have no cap.
